name: topic-picker
title: Topic Picker
description: Topic chips drifting in rows that run opposite ways; picking one pops it in a soft colour.

perf.budget: Each row is one looping UI-thread transform; chips only re-render when picked.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest: the rows drift continuously. Chips carry no shadow, which took frames from 28 to 22 ms here.

a11y.reducedMotion: Rows hold still and scroll by hand instead of drifting; chips do not pop.
a11y.screenReader: Each topic is a checkbox with its checked state; copies used for the loop are hidden. The submit button is disabled until enough are picked.
a11y.touchTarget: Chips are 48 pt tall; the submit button is 60 pt.
